text:
Priya N: quick flag ran into a publishguard fail when landing the sample-sdk PR. regen-check produced a diff and sdk-parity tests also showed an auth/retry integration flake in CI.

Lee W: can you paste the diff? curious whether it's actual api surface change or ordering noise

Priya N: here's the snippet from packages/sdk/src/types/api.ts:
```diff
- export interface CreateThingRequest { name: string; priority?: "low" | "high" }
+ export interface CreateThingRequest { priority?: "high" | "low"; name: string }
```
ordering only, but the SDK parity job failed downstream because the sample-app e2e expects field ordering in a snapshot (ugh).

Diego M: snapshot depending on property order is a bug in the sample-app tests, we shouldn't gate semver on that. but the CI guard flagged it as a minor change because typegen changed.

CI Bot: regen-check  job failed on runner: ubuntu-22.04-2, diff detected in packages/sdk/src/types/api.ts. publish-blocked: true

Priya N: extra wrinkle: auth/retry test flake showed up in the same matrix build: intermittent 401 -> retry logic didn't kick in on one node image. could be node version or environment variable ordering.

Lee W: that sounds like two separate issues colliding in the same release. we should decouple: 1) fix test fragility in sample-app snapshots 2) make typegen deterministic 3) root-cause the retry flake

Diego M: proposal: treat ordering-only typegen diffs as patch (no semver bump) by enhancing changelog rule to run a lightweight AST compare that ignores property order. also add a sample-app test change to compare by keys/values rather than string snapshot.

Priya N: Agreed. For the retry flake I reproduced locally on node:18-bullseye with env VARS shuffled. Looks like our auth middleware reads AUTH_RETRY env in process.env but tests spawn child process that doesn't inherit all vars on some runners.

Lee W: can you share repro steps?

Priya N: repro: 
1) checkout sample-app branches
2) NODE_ENV=test AUTH_RETRY=3 npm run test:integration
3) flip order: AUTH_RETRY=3 NODE_ENV=test npm run test:integration -> flaky fail seen sometimes

Diego M: that reproduction suggests a race in test harness setup, not Node itself. probably tests are reading env at module eval time and spawn timing differs across runners. add a helper to explicitly set process.env in test before requiring auth module.

Priya N: I'll open two small PRs:
- PR A: make snapshot assertions key-based and tolerate ordering (sample-app)
- PR B: stable-sort post-process in typegen generator + CI check
- PR C: test harness fix to ensure AUTH_RETRY set before modules load

CI Bot: publishflow guard: blocked -> awaiting human review. related issues: #4321 typegen-order, #4322 test-snapshot-order, #4323 auth-env-race

release-bot: Manual override allowed if a follow-up issue is created and PRs merged before EOD. See release checklist item 7.

Lee W: thumbs up on that plan. prioritize the test harness fix and the snapshot tolerance so we can get the publish unblocked quickly. typegen stable-sort can land as patch in the next minor if needed but prefer to merge before release.

Priya N: ETA: I'll open PRs in next 2 hours. tagging @release oncall once green. thanks folks. :pray:

Diego M: also adding a short doc blurb in devex/wiki: "Autogenerated type semver guidelines" so SDK authors know ordering-only diffs don't require a minor bump.

Lee W: nice. assign owners and mark done when merged. :white_check_mark:
